instruction: You are the quality engineer for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-054 (Quarantine an expired chemical lot). Confirm expiry, remaining on-hand, and quality direction before posting the inventory status movement. After the documented Oracle operation, reply in the existing Slack thread; then write the outcome into the existing control-workbook cell. Return exactly: inspection_reference, quality_result, controlled_quantity.

Communicate the resulting identifier and effective date; never infer approval from silence.
